# Agellus Capital

> Lower middle-market private equity for essential, non-discretionary services businesses in the United States and Canada.

- Name: Agellus Capital, LLC
- Headquarters: 7701 Forsyth Boulevard, Suite 350, Clayton, MO 63105, United States
- Phone: 314.408.5600
- Canonical site: https://www.agellus.com
- Contact: https://www.agellus.com/contact
